question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

She began to think more about the __origins__ of his views.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"origins"** means the point or place where something begins, arises, or is derived. (मूल)

 
 
• **Example: **The **origins **of the universe have always intrigued scientists.
 
 
 
• **"Destiny" **refers to the events that will necessarily happen to a particular person or thing in the future. (भाग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **She believed it was her destiny to become a musician.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'origins' **is **'destiny'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Influence **(प्रभाव): The capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** His influence on the team was evident in their improved performance.
 
 
 
• **Inheritors **(उत्तराधिकारी): People who receive something from a predecessor, such as property or a title, usually after someone's death.
 
 
• **Example: **As** inheritors** of the estate, they were responsible for maintaining it.
 
 
 
• **Author** (लेखक): A writer of a book, article, or report.
 
 
• **Example:** The author of the novel received numerous awards for his work.
